overview: The animation depicts a renowned restaurant known for its mysterious cuisine, attracting visitors from around the world. Drawn by its reputation, the protagonist blindly follows the crowd to the restaurant. Eager to fit in, they even change their appearance to match social expectations. Upon realizing something is wrong inside, the protagonist becomes the target of everyone’s scrutiny. Unable to withstand the pressure of the crowd, and seeking the security of belonging, the protagonist denies their own perceptions—ignoring the stench of decay—and is transformed into a fly, willingly consuming the rotten food. This betrayal of reality represents the root of fear. Through this animation, we aim to encourage audiences to value independent thinking and the courage to question, prompting reflection on the importance of individuality and personal integrity.
title: The Followers

data.overview: 在一間知名的餐廳提供神祕的料理，主角也慕名前往，送上的料理精緻，掀開華麗的外表卻發現裡頭都是腐爛的，眾人不僅毫無疑惑還吃得津津有味，拒絕嘗試的主角頓時變成眾人眼中的異類，不懂的 欣賞名廚料理的無知者，而主廚也出現向他推銷著，最終抵不過群眾壓力變形為蒼蠅， 自願吃著腐爛食物。
